core_principles: Monochrome dominance: 95% of UI is black, white, and gray. Color is strictly reserved for status (Pass/Fail) and primary active states.
Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px sharp borders to separate dense information panels.
High Density: Control Room layout. Minimal padding where data matters, generous padding in hero/empty states.
Typography as UI: Use JetBrains Mono for all testing data, tags, and locators to feel like a pro developer tool.

spacing_and_layout.shadows: None. Rely on 1px borders and slight background shifts.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-zinc-800), no shadow.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border.
surface_strategies.modals: Glassmorphism (Crystal/Apple variant): bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10

components.strategy: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts. Heavily customize Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, dropdowns, and tabs.
mandatory_attributes: data-testid on all interactive and informational elements

login.layout: Split screen or central card with geometric abstract background.
login.notes: Use a dark overlay (bg-black/80) over the background image to ensure text contrast. The login form should be a crisp, border-lined card.

dashboard.layout: Left sidebar nav. Top sticky header for breadcrumbs and user profile. Main area: Bento grid of metrics (Pass rate, Flaky tests, Executions).
dashboard.notes: Dense data layout. Use recharts with monochrome grids and semantic line colors (green/red).

test_builder.layout: Three-pane layout. Left: Locators/Elements. Middle: Drag-and-drop steps (plain English). Right: Properties/Data bindings.
test_builder.notes: Steps should resemble code blocks but be visual cards. Use JetBrains Mono for variable names.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Outfit, Satoshi, and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for any text.
Set the Tailwind base colors to the zinc scale defined.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, and key metric displays have data-testid attributes for testing.
Construct the left sidebar nav with lucide-react icons.
Apply the 'Grid Borders' layout for the Dashboard: tables and metric cards should have crisp 1px borders with border-zinc-800.
Use standard Shadcn components but override their border-radius to rounded-sm and remove soft shadows.
Use the abstract architecture images for the Login screen background with a heavy bg-black/80 overlay to ensure text contrast.
